en.description:
Speed Streets 3D brings real-time single and multiplayer 3D racing to Apple Watch in a way that feels native, fast, and instantly fun using only Apple Digital Crown Control.

Play a progressive, difficult increasing and fun campaign, jump into quick races or play against real opponents in an international championship. Push for best times with responsive digital crown control. Every run is designed for short sessions while still delivering depth, progression, and replay value.

Why players love it:

True 3D racing gameplay optimized for Apple Watch
Fast arcade action with smooth, pick-up-and-play races
Multiple cars to unlock, each with a distinct feel and stats
Different tracks and challenges with escalating speed
Multiplayer against real opponents
Designed for quick sessions
Whether you have 30 seconds or 10 minutes, Speed Streets 3D delivers premium handheld-style racing directly on your wrist.
Minimum: Apple Watch Series 8 or later
Recommended device: Apple Watch Series 9 or later.
en.releaseNotes:
- Jet Engine trail prize in Championship
- Improve multiplayer loading screen
- Improve multiplayer opponent rendering
en.subtitle: Multiplayer 3D Racing Car Game
